# RSI Plaza

Open **Model Plaza → RSI Plaza** to explore research projects developed by Scientist.

## Browse a case

Search by project name or scientific topic. Open a case to read its README, browse the project directory and preview source code, reports and supported text files. The case records its research scope and available evaluation evidence.

Choose **Download ZIP** to save the project package. Read the included README and dependencies before reproducing the work in your own environment. A research result may be incomplete or fail its scientific acceptance criteria; inspect the report before relying on its claims.

## Visibility

Your private research projects remain visible only to you. Public cases are selected by the platform operator, with author and sharing information. Sharing a case does not expose other conversations or unpublished research files.

RSI Plaza is a repository gallery. It does not start predictions, publish MCP tools or register models with Agent or Researcher. Use the regular Model Plaza for enabled platform prediction models, and [Scientist](./Scientist.md) to start a new research topic.

Existing operator-owned local RSI libraries can also appear as recorded cases in local mode. Their packages contain the saved model program, parameters and assessment; a recorded artifact is not a claim of complete study reproduction. These libraries are not exposed online without separate case publication.
